modules_list.description: Whether the mod_spam_filter module is enabled in ejabberd.yml

spam_filter.description: Configuration for the ejabberd spam filter module

block_content_regexes.description: Block messages matching any of these PCRE regex patterns (case-sensitive by default)

block_content_substrings.description: Block messages containing any of these substrings (case-insensitive)

block_from_jids.description: Block all messages from these JIDs

ignore_jids.description: List of JIDs to exclude from spam filtering

log_blocked.description: Log blocked messages to ejabberd logs

max_message_size.description: Maximum allowed message size in bytes (0 = no limit)

max_recipients.description: Maximum number of recipients per message (0 = no limit)

score_threshold.description: Global spam score threshold above which messages are blocked
Spam score at or above which the user’s outgoing messages are blocked

warning_threshold.description: Global spam score at which warnings are issued to the sender
